title: Financial Sentiment Lexicon — 金融情感词典
description: Build a domain-specific sentiment dictionary with 500+ Chinese financial terms across 7 categories (growth, decline, risk, opportunity, market, regulatory, neutral). The lexicon MUST support negation detection (不看好, 未达预期), degree modifiers (非常, 极其, 略微), and be loadable from external YAML file for user customization. This is a Wave 1 foundation dependency for F-039 News Sentiment Classifier. It extends the existing LexiconAnalyzer in synapse/event/social.py.

criteria: 500+ sentiment terms across 7 categories: [growth=80+, decline=70+, risk=60+, opportunity=50+, market=60+, regulatory=50+, neutral=100+]
Negation detection correctly flips sentiment for 90%+ cases
Degree modifier handling with 3 levels: [strong=1.5x, moderate=1.0x, weak=0.5x]
16+ unit tests pass: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_sentiment_lexicon.py -p no:asyncio -q (exit code 0)
All frozen dataclasses use frozen=True, slots=True pattern
convergence.verification: py -m pytest tests/unit/test_sentiment_lexicon.py -p no:asyncio -q && ls synapse/nlp/lexicon/*.yaml | wc -l
convergence.definition_of_done: 500+ term sentiment lexicon with negation/degree handling, YAML-based configuration, and clean frozen dataclass API

files.change: 500+ sentiment terms in YAML format with category, score, negation_sensitive flags
LexiconLoader class: load from YAML, validate schema, cache in memory, <100ms load time
EnhancedLexiconAnalyzer extending social.py LexiconAnalyzer with negation/degree/yaml support
NegationDetector: context window-based negation detection (不/未/没/非/无 + 3-token window)
DegreeModifier: 3-level degree detection (非常/极其→strong, 较为/比较→moderate, 略微/稍→weak)
16+ tests covering: term count, category distribution, negation flipping, degree modification, YAML loading, custom terms, scorer integration, edge cases
